decoder.rule: count GF spikes per side in [now - window_ms, now); both >= n -> JUMP; left only -> RIGHT; right only -> LEFT; neither -> NOOP

brain.input: k*loom_L on every left LC4+LPLC2 cell, k*loom_R on the right (no heterogeneity, ASSUMPTION)
brain.readout: DNp01 L/R spikes in the last 300 ms (escape profile)
brain.warmup: 5000 steps with no input after the reset; game clock 0 = end of warm-up; warm-up spikes not used

detector.signal: loom(side) = max(0, D_t - D_{t-1}), D = mean darkness (1 - px/255) of the half
detector.halves: left = columns < W/2, right = columns >= W/2
detector.status: ASSUMPTION — dark-looming, growth-only; not derived from the connectome

rules.p99_frames: brainless bot (θ chosen on the row) on training seeds 0-9; s = 1: M7c's value
rules.ceiling: slow rows: brainless == oracle on all 10 eval seeds; s = 1: M7c's (dodge_v2 72)
rules.control: same seed, warm-up, then 5 s with no input (M7c2)
rules.p1_episodes: training seeds 0-9 at the grid's top k (k = 5120/p99)
rules.first_action: first non-NOOP decoder output while the obstacle is on screen; time = that tick's end
rules.correct: dodge: the move away from the pillar's side; jump: JUMP
rules.p1: median lead of correct first actions rises strictly with s in both families
rules.p2: beat the random bot (selected k, eval seeds) in at least one slow row
rules.noise_expectation: ASSUMPTION: control decoder onsets as a Poisson process, rate below
